name: Living Anew
overview: The year is 2026. The life of Dima, a forty-year-old emergency doctor, has gone downhill: his wife has left, his colleagues despise him, and alcohol has become his best friend. But one day, while undergoing an MRI scan, Dima is suddenly transported back to 2002. He is an eighteen—year-old boy again, his mother is alive, the love of his life is still free, and the fateful meeting with his ex-wife has not happened. He gets a chance to live his life anew and maybe fix everything.
